reason: The matching primary full-article text identifies the critical repeated-measures MANOVA, but does not explicitly report its analytic N. It reports an item-specific paired-observation range of 14,163–14,266 and refers to unsupplied Supplementary Information for exact badge counts. The Methods total of 14,266 paired responses is not established as the five-measure MANOVA analytic sample. Exact N cannot be obtained from these overlapping item samples; no df-based derivation was made.
